description_en: Changes the endpoint of an AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster
description_zh: 调用ModifyClusterConnectionString接口修改实例的网络连接地址
kebab_example: aliyun adb modify-cluster-connection-string --db-cluster-id am-bp18934i73vb0000 --connection-string-prefix test-123 --current-connection-string am-bp18934i73vb0000.ads.aliyuncs.com --port 3306 --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyClusterConnectionString

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition cluster.

>  You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition clusters within a region
parameters.help_zh:
数仓版集群ID。
> 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查看目标地域所有数仓版集群的集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The prefix of the public endpoint.

*   The prefix can contain lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-). It must start with a lowercase letter.
*   The prefix can be up to 30 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
自定义连接地址的前缀。
- 以小写字母开头，可包含小写字母、数字和中划线（-）。
- 长度5-29个字符
parameters.name: connection_string_prefix

parameters.help_en:
The current public endpoint of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition cluster.

>  You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143384.html operation to query the public endpoint of the cluster
parameters.help_zh:
要修改的数仓版集群的连接地址。
> 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143384.html接口查看集群的连接地址
parameters.name: current_connection_string

parameters.help_en: The port number. Set the value to **3306**
parameters.help_zh: 端口号，固定为**3306**暂时不支持修改
parameters.name: port
